scripts.dev: bash -lc 'trap "pkill -f ""vite"" || true; pkill -f ""tsx"" || true; pkill -f ""concurrently"" || true" EXIT INT TERM; lsof -ti tcp:5050,5173,5174,5175,5176,5177 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,dashboard "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 --strictPort" "npm --prefix dashboard run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174 --strictPort"'
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix dashboard run build
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web" "npm run start:dash"
